references: A1 or rectangular range; sheet-qualified or local; absolute/mixed dollar flags preserved; sheet names may be quoted and contain escaped apostrophes
formula_functions: preserve all formula tokens except supported references; no expression evaluation; reject external workbook refs, structured table refs, 3D refs and dynamic address functions INDIRECT/OFFSET
ranges: insertion strictly inside referenced interval expands it; insertion before or at first position shifts it; deletion keeps bounding rectangle of surviving referenced cells; empty result becomes #REF!
names: global or sheet-local simple cell/range definitions move with referenced sheet; references to the name keep spelling and scope
cell_movement: move source cells according to structural edits; reference movement is not relative-copy translation
preserve: unaffected literal strings, ordinary styles, sheet order and stable cell content identities; source unchanged
